outcome: Four or more antenatal care (ANC) visits
Postnatal care (PNC) by a skilled provider for the mother
PNC by a skilled provider for the baby
Delivery with a skilled birth attendant (SBA)
cohort: Women who had given birth in the three years preceding the 2011 and 2016 Demographic and Health Surveys in Uganda, and their children, from SMGL intervention and control districts.
finding: While both SMGL and control areas showed significant improvements in maternal and child health indicators between 2011 and 2016, the gains were largely not significantly different between the groups, with the exception of blood pressure measurement among women with ANC and births delivered by Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was one of two indicators for which the change in coverage was significantly different between the SMGL intervention districts and control areas.
followup_time: Up to 3 years after birth (for births in the preceding three years)
